findings.title: NullPointerException in remove(String) when alias does not exist and cache key is invalidated
findings.body: In `InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.remove(String alias)`, if the identity provider for `alias` does not exist (`storedIdp == null`) and `isInvalid(cacheKey)` is true (for example, if the IDP was already removed earlier in the same transaction), `registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp)` is called with `null` and immediately throws a `NullPointerException` at `idp.getInternalId()` instead of returning `false` as required by the `IdentityProviderStorageProvider.remove` contract. `registerIDPInvalidation` (or the call site) should guard against `storedIdp == null`.

findings.title: Cleanup in testCacheIDPForLogin uses literal string "alias" instead of the created IDP alias
findings.body: At lines 381 and 425 in `OrganizationCacheTest.testCacheIDPForLogin`, cleanup is registered as `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove);` using the literal string `"alias"` rather than the actual IDP alias (`"idp-alias-" + i` / `"idp-alias-20"`). When cleanup runs after the test, attempting to remove the non-existent `"alias"` IDP will fail with a 404 NotFoundException and leave the 20+ created identity providers behind in the test realm.
